articles.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
articles.excerpt: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
articles.summary: 让 AI coding agent 学会像团队里最懒的资深工程师那样思考：能不写的代码就不写，优先复用现有实现，用最少改动解决问题。适合接入 Claude Code 等 agent 工作流作为行为约束，抑制 AI 过度设计、堆砌无意义的新代码。

articles.title: mattpocock/skills
articles.excerpt: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
articles.summary: 前端工程师 Matt Pocock 从其 .agents 目录整理出的 agent 技能集合，面向真实工程场景而非玩具 demo。内容以可复用的 skill 配置为主，可直接接入支持 skills 机制的 AI 编码助手，帮助开发者定制贴合自身习惯的 agent 行为。

articles.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
articles.excerpt: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
articles.summary: NVIDIA 开源的自主 AI agent 运行时，主打安全与私密隔离，让 agent 在受控环境中执行任务。面向需要把 agent 部署到生产或敏感数据场景的团队，解决自主执行带来的权限边界、沙箱隔离与数据私密性问题。

articles.title: firebase/firebase-ios-sdk
articles.excerpt: Firebase SDK for Apple App Development
articles.summary: Firebase 官方 Apple 平台 SDK，覆盖 iOS、macOS、tvOS 等系统，提供身份认证、实时数据库、Firestore、云存储、崩溃分析等后端能力。移动与桌面应用开发者可借此快速接入 Google 后端服务，省去自建服务端的工作。

articles.title: mvschwarz/openrig
articles.excerpt: Build your own network of agents from Claude Code, Codex and Pi: persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.
articles.summary: 把 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等不同 AI agent 组织成一张协作网络：每个 agent 拥有固定角色、共享上下文和明确归属的工作，形成可长期运行的团队而非一次性会话。适合需要多 agent 分工推进复杂工程任务的开发者。

articles.title: cursor/plugins
articles.excerpt: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
articles.summary: Cursor 官方插件规范与官方插件仓库，定义了编辑器如何扩展 AI 编程能力。开发者可据此编写并发布自定义插件，把内部工具链或领域知识接入 Cursor，团队也能基于同一规范统一插件生态与使用体验。

articles.title: obra/superpowers
articles.excerpt: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
articles.summary: 一套面向 AI agent 的技能框架与软件开发方法论，主张用可组合的 skills 驱动 agent 完成实际工程任务，而非依赖一次性提示词。适合希望把 agent 稳定纳入日常开发流程、提升交付可靠性的团队与个人工程师参考落地。

articles.title: mksglu/context-mode
articles.excerpt: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
articles.summary: 针对 AI 编码 agent 的上下文窗口优化方案：把工具输出放入沙箱，最多减少约 98% 的 token 占用；同时持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP 与 hooks 在 17 个平台上统一路由。适合长会话、多工具调用的 agent 开发场景。

articles.title: heygen-com/hyperframes
articles.excerpt: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
articles.summary: 用写 HTML 的方式渲染视频，专为 AI agent 设计。开发者或 agent 只需输出 HTML 页面即可生成视频内容，绕开复杂的剪辑与时间轴工具链，适合需要程序化、批量产出视频的场景。

articles.title: earendil-works/pi
articles.excerpt: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
articles.summary: AI agent 工具包，内置统一的 LLM API、agent loop、终端 TUI 以及编码 agent 命令行工具。开发者可直接用它搭建自己的 agent 应用，或基于内置的 coding agent CLI 做二次开发，避免重复实现底层调度与模型接入。

articles.title: tile-ai/tilelang
articles.excerpt: Domain-specific language designed to streamline the development of high-performance GPU/CPU/Accelerators kernels
articles.summary: 面向高性能算子开发的领域特定语言，用更高层抽象编写 GPU、CPU 及各类加速器 kernel，简化手写底层代码的工作量。适合做深度学习算子优化、需要跨硬件生成高性能 kernel 的工程与研究人员。

articles.title: pablostanley/yoinks
articles.excerpt: yoink any video from your terminal. no shady ads.
articles.summary: 终端里的视频下载工具，敲一条命令即可保存视频，全程没有弹窗广告和诱导下载页面。适合习惯命令行的用户批量保存网络视频，替代充斥广告与跳转的在线下载网站。

articles.title: HunxByts/GhostTrack
articles.excerpt: Useful tool to track location or mobile number
articles.summary: 用于追踪位置或手机号码的开源工具，属于 OSINT 信息收集方向。适合安全研究、授权渗透测试与情报分析人员使用，普通用户需在合法合规、获得授权的前提下操作，避免侵犯他人隐私。

articles.title: pbakaus/impeccable
articles.excerpt: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
articles.summary: 一套设计语言，用于提升 AI 编码工具（harness）的设计产出质量。通过向 agent 提供明确的设计规范与约束，减少生成界面时的审美偏差，适合用 AI 生成前端 UI、又希望产物可用的开发者。

articles.title: Friedrich-M/UniMate
articles.excerpt: [SIGGRAPH Asia 2026] UniMate: One Unified Model to Animate Diverse Skeletons
articles.summary: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 论文项目，提出用一个统一模型为不同骨架结构驱动动画，无需为每套骨架单独制作动画数据。适合角色动画、游戏与图形学研究场景，降低跨骨架复用动作的成本。

articles.title: We want you to build the next Git platform on Cloudflare

articles.title: AI Search is now generally available
articles.excerpt: AI Search is now generally available. It embeds image pixels directly for visual search, runs optical character recognition on scanned PDFs, accepts files up to 10 MiB, and works with any chat model. Here's what's new and how pricing works.

articles.title: Support for modern cryptographic algorithms in Workers
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Workers is adding opt-in support for post-quantum-resistant algorithms ML-KEM and ML-DSA. You can try it today.

articles.title: Introducing Cloudflare Basin: an open, serverless data platform, now generally available
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Basin is built on Apache Iceberg and R2 Object Storage. With general availability, developers can ingest, manage, and query large datasets at scale without paying data egress fees.

articles.title: Cloudflare Impact reaches $100 million in donations
articles.excerpt: This week, Cloudflare's Impact programs will reach $100 million in donated services. This milestone means that thousands of entities including journalists, civil society, state and local governments, election management bodies, and public schools are being protected from cyberattacks.

articles.title: Cut your AI spend with AI Gateway's Auto Router
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare AI Gateway now features a model router that evaluates request complexity using an edge-deployed classifier to select the optimal model. By balancing expected output quality against token costs, organizations can dramatically cut AI spend while maintaining performance.

articles.title: Detect and send production issues straight to your agent
articles.excerpt: You can now use built-in error monitoring in Cloudflare Workers to group production failures and send stack traces, logs, traces, and application context directly to a coding agent to investigate further and open a pull request.

articles.title: Simplifying domains for people and agents
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Registrar’s new search delivers fast, transparent results across 420+ extensions using Workers, Durable Objects, and WebSockets. Its expanded API and cf CLI also let agents search, register, and transfer domains.

articles.title: Monetization Gateway beta: charge AI agents for consumption with HTTP 402

articles.title: Pay Per Use: when AI uses your work, you should get paid
articles.excerpt: Pay Per Use is now in beta. AI companies report when they use publishers’ content, and Cloudflare handles billing, payouts, and reporting, so our customers are paid according to use.

articles.title: Identify AI model overuse with User Insights
articles.excerpt: AI Gateway User Insights now adds task, model, turn, and user categories to help teams understand AI adoption and make better model decisions. This is available free to AI Gateway users.

articles.title: Cloudflare Containers, rebuilt to scale agent sandboxes
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Containers now start 6x faster, let your agent choose each sandbox's image and instance type at runtime, and support filesystem snapshots in public beta, all controlled from a Durable Object.

articles.title: The Internet has a second audience
articles.excerpt: More than half the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated, and AI agents are the fastest-growing part of it. We're giving site owners the tools to see who's visiting, decide who gets in, and charge for access.
